name: @mos/integrations
description: MOS v2.0 connector provider contract (INTEG-001) — the four-layer provider-integrations authority: versioned tenant-scoped ProviderDefinition (what a provider IS — kind, transport contract surface, declared capability surface; never credentials) → ProviderImplementation (concrete versioned implementation with status available|unavailable|degraded|unknown — UNKNOWN preserved first-class — and evidence refs) → MerchantClientInstance (tenant-scoped binding of an implementation to a merchant/client identity carrying a CredentialRef HANDLE ONLY — credential values never enter the control plane, they resolve at the declared substrate secret-store seam) → AvailabilityCapability (EXPLICIT capability instances at explicit versions with declared constraints, resolving through the @mos/capabilities vocabulary — an instance without a capability record provides NOTHING). ProviderInteractionPort is the single call surface: rights gate (RightsContextRef, fail-closed, @mos/rights vocabulary) precedes every call and every interaction records the §30 observability record. No real network — the transport seam is a declared port with a disclosed deterministic in-memory double. Provider specifics live in DATA, never in code: the package exports provider-neutral contracts only (test-pinned).
